name: Employees
description: Track employee time, bill customers for billable hours and run payroll, with time pulled from timesheet.io.

tabs.label: Payroll
tabs.help: The currency everything is in, and the accounts pay runs are posted to. Each can also be chosen when posting.

tabs.label: Billing hours
tabs.help: Where billed time is recorded, for Sales to invoice.

tabs.label: timesheet.io
tabs.help: Keeps Ledger's time entries and timesheet.io's tasks the same, both ways.

fields.label: Currency
fields.help: Pay rates, billing rates, billings and pay runs are all in this currency.

fields.label: Wages expense
fields.help: Debited with gross pay when a pay run is posted.

fields.label: Employer payroll costs
fields.help: The employer's share: pension, insurance, payroll taxes.

fields.label: Payroll liabilities
fields.help: Credited with amounts withheld from pay and the employer's share, until they are remitted.

fields.label: Billable hours
fields.help: Billable hours go by themselves to a clearing account (CLR-EMPLOYEES-BILLABLE), one transaction per time entry tagged with customer, employee and project. Add it under Settings → Sales → Billable costs.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create one at my.timesheet.io → Development → API keys. It looks like ts_xxxx.yyyy.

fields.label: Time zone
fields.help: For time entered in Ledger, which starts at 9:00 there, e.g. America/Toronto. Empty: UTC.

fields.label: Days to pull
fields.help: Each sync re-reads this many days back, so edits made in timesheet.io are picked up.

fields.label: Pull when someone signs in to Ledger
